description: Provider-neutral golden scenarios (M19 seed + M24 hardening). Executed unchanged against both composition roots.

scenarios.name: composition parity
scenarios.assert: netsons and aws share apiContractVersion and workerProtocolVersion

scenarios.name: transport poll semantics
scenarios.assert: polling and wss adapters parse identical poll payloads

scenarios.name: worker application messages
scenarios.assert: job-protocol heartbeat and job accepted include protocolVersion

scenarios.name: worker service discovery
scenarios.assert: discovery advertises DRAINING polling and ACTIVE wss control planes

scenarios.name: dual transport coexistence
scenarios.assert: one Worker session routes by controlPlaneId without cross-routing

scenarios.name: protocol compatibility window
scenarios.assert: WORKER_PROTOCOL_COMPATIBILITY_WINDOW covers advertised PROTOCOL_VERSION

scenarios.name: composition drift canary
scenarios.assert: deliberately broken composition fails assertCompositionParity

scenarios.name: transport drift canary
scenarios.assert: deliberately broken transport fails assertPollParsingParity

scenarios.name: provider parity report
scenarios.assert: generated M24-provider-parity-report.json shows parityAsserted

scenarios.name: duplicate semantic ownership
scenarios.assert: provider packages contain no job-dispatch/billing/prisma.job domain logic

scenarios.name: dual control-plane routing
scenarios.assert: in-flight Netsons execution stays on Netsons while AWS is ACTIVE for new work

scenarios.name: payment idempotency golden seed (HARD-004)
scenarios.assert: duplicate credit grant and payment reconciliation remain idempotent

scenarios.name: compatibility matrix (HARD-007)
scenarios.assert: API contract, protocol window, and migration history match fixture

scenarios.name: backend conformance manifest
scenarios.assert: shared backend conformance matrix executes on both profiles

scenarios.name: divergence rejection
scenarios.assert: broken composition and transport adapters fail CI parity checks

scenarios.name: protocol fail-closed
scenarios.assert: unsupported protocol versions reject with remediation

scenarios.name: worker version handshake
scenarios.assert: supported worker versions pass cloud handshake

scenarios.name: backend transition independence
scenarios.assert: provider switch does not require binary when transports match

scenarios.name: dual-CP restart
scenarios.assert: Worker rebuilds multi-transport session during DRAINING/ACTIVE overlap

scenarios.name: signed worker release
scenarios.assert: tampered Worker release manifests fail signature verification

scenarios.name: worker transport protocol header
scenarios.assert: Worker cloud client sends x-kivro-protocol-version

scenarios.name: protocol overlap during transition
scenarios.assert: ACTIVE and DRAINING protocol windows overlap within matrix

scenarios.name: revoked worker policy
scenarios.assert: revoked Worker versions fail cloud handshake

scenarios.name: openclaw adapter range
scenarios.assert: unsupported OpenClaw versions fail cloud handshake

scenarios.name: staged update persistence
scenarios.assert: Worker store persists staged update state across restarts

scenarios.name: fault injection matrix
scenarios.assert: M26 fault scenarios wired to convergence tests

scenarios.name: duplicate job completion
scenarios.assert: COMPLETED job re-completion triggers idempotent capture only

scenarios.name: redis non-authoritative
scenarios.assert: job and payment truth cannot be Redis-only

scenarios.name: restore invariants
scenarios.assert: isolated restore harness rejects duplicate ledger keys

scenarios.name: webhook duplicate delivery
scenarios.assert: buyer webhook signatures verify deterministically

scenarios.name: control-plane outage routing
scenarios.assert: in-flight execution stays on owning control plane

scenarios.name: worker reconnect after restart
scenarios.assert: expired DISPATCHED offers recovered on reconcile

scenarios.name: duplicate stripe webhook
scenarios.assert: stripeEventId dedupe prevents double handling

scenarios.name: redis cache loss recovery plan
scenarios.assert: rehydration targets PostgreSQL authoritative stores

scenarios.name: transport ack ambiguity
scenarios.assert: reconnect preserves transport ack idempotency keys
